row.notes: Builds an eaid:// asset URI: copies the path from resource header (+9, up to 0x400), prefixes eaid://%s unless already prefixed, hashes with Ne_Hash_Md5U64 and Ne_HashedName_FromString. Callers Game_Read_HighlightAssetsConfig. Addon: eaid:// resource id scheme hashed with MD5 (u64). vp4-verify partial/disagree
